A.name: One truthful model-visible delivery boundary
A.canonical_data: Archive original tool content through current owner/SHA/source_material verification before presentation changes. Artifact carries only owner/tool/observation_ref/original SHA/public content digest; no second raw body.
A.normal_data: Explicit normal-sized source/observation reads reach the next effective model input unaltered. Large report bodies may be explicitly deferred with exact observation_path/ref/digest; full selected source material to independent text tools stays unchanged.
A.control_data: Keep complete tool-specific actual states, limitations, findings, check/coverage remaining work and processing notes required to decide adoption/correction. Do not infer semantic pass from success/completed or receipt.
A.single_final_entry: TaskContext.awrap_model_call transforms request.messages once, preserving ToolMessage role/call/name/status/media. It validates artifact against canonical observation and reconstructs the same public result when framework offload/history cleanup would otherwise hide it. Idempotent; no re-summary or field-name clipping.
A.compatibility: Old checkpoints without new artifact retain explicit old recovery, not retroactive claims of delivery; old raw receipt/request identities unchanged. source_material verification stays over original exact UTF8 bytes, never re-encoded public JSON.
A.capacity: No invented replacement character cap. 2m reservation bound is not model context capacity. Use only genuinely known model-profile/capacity semantics if verified; otherwise state capacity preflight unavailable. Data may be deferred with explicit extent; if control itself cannot be delivered, expose delivery_incomplete with exact counts/recovery, never silently truncate or mark fulfilled.

perform_assigned_artifact_review: Current public function returns only submit receipt review_ref plus reused. A.capacity_clarification: Main must not claim an existing actual-context admission mechanism unless verified. Token reservation bound is not context size; no new tokenizer, fixed character cap or hidden semantic slice is approved just to make this batch pass.

B.name: Shared review assignment/observation/publication contract
B.historical_comparison: Only exact ContentNode refs explicitly declared in this immutable task required_read_refs may be historical dependencies outside snapshot. Admission resolves actual ref; publication/reconcile require originating reviewer actual whole-body read before record boundary. They never become new target, criterion or snapshot member. External SourceArtifact exception retained.
B.scope_identity: New assignments require task-local unique scope_id. Existing normalized task/hash/receipts unchanged; old ambiguity must reject before provider with exact matching indexes, never guess/rename or alter saved scope.
B.reuse: Use current readiness, review_identity, receipt/extent matching and ContentStore membership path; no new task framework.

C.name: Document semantics separate from presentation
C.directory: Only root report depth0 emits document TOC; nested report content remains unchanged and rendered.
C.content: One existing Markdown parser/renderer; apply presentation to rendered elements, not reinterpret selected lines as plain text.
C.neighbor_risk: Existing validate_layout rejects paragraph control intersecting a Markdown table via PARAGRAPH_CONTROL_INTERSECTS_MARKDOWN_TABLE. Neo initially raised a possible legal-table-line split; actual source check refutes that trigger in the validated export path. Keep this boundary and test unrelated controls preserve neighboring tables. Valid list/soft-line paragraphs still require one parse.
oracles: Nested report one TOC and no missing body
Controlled image survives with original bytes/ref and formatting
Multi-line Markdown table remains one same-cell table when header/row control applies
Current explicit margin/font/spacing values appear in actual OOXML; this is rendering proof, not proof Agent picked the standard
C.approved_implementation_detail: Extend existing _add_markdown with optional paragraph_formatter(paragraph, source_lines) based on existing token.map. No callback preserves old path. emit_text binds styles only and does not split source into independently parsed Markdown. Apply callback after existing list/heading structure; equal paragraph styles merge once, genuinely conflicting declarations reject with source locations. Cover existing fence/hr fallback where applicable; no parallel parser.
C.preserve_explicit_heading: Existing ParagraphLayout.heading_level may extract one interior source soft-line as a separate heading. A whole-paragraph formatter alone regresses that feature. Explicit heading boundaries should be handled inside the one existing token/inline pass, retaining bold/italic/link state; ordinary formatting must not split Markdown paragraphs/lists. Do not remove the existing typography test or impose a blanket new list ban.
C.regression_status: Final same-token renderer verified, including explicit interior heading, cross-line emphasis/link/list state. Ordinary selectors apply to existing rendered paragraph; conflicting declarations reject. Finite compatibility adjustment disclosed.
